publisher.name: Lobbying Disclosure Act public disclosure system

dataset.name: LD-203 contribution reports
dataset.description: Semiannual registrant and lobbyist reports with explicit zero-report state, PAC names, and contribution or expense items.

acquisition.pagination: Offset pages reached through next URLs; accepted page size is 25; a query parameter is required beyond page one; partitions require a convergence pass.

partitions.name: posted_date
partitions.source: dt_posted selected with strict before/after filters and filtered locally

acquisition.retry_policy: Bound retries, honor Retry-After on 429, checkpoint complete pages, and never publish a failed page as an empty result.

physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve absent, explicit null, empty string, empty array, and invalid typed values as distinct states.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Sorted observed JSON paths with JSON kinds and array cardinality, plus this contract version and reviewed OpenAPI overrides.

identity.occurrence_locator: snapshot digest + normalized request + page number + one-based results ordinal
identity.record_version: filing_uuid + SHA-256 of canonical record JSON
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every occurrence; conflicting content for one UUID creates separate versions and blocks the affected projection.

time_fields.meaning: Publisher posting timestamp with source UTC offset.
Exact reported date for the disclosed contribution or expense item.
Current nested registrant master update timestamp, not the item date.

money_fields.meaning: Losslessly parsed amount reported for one LD-203 item.

code_fields.meaning: Original or amendment code for the semiannual period.
Organization or lobbyist conditional record shape.
FECA, honorary expense, meeting expense, presidential library expense, or inaugural committee code.

rules: Treat no_contributions as tri-state; source null is not explicit false.
Organization filers have a null lobbyist; lobbyist filers retain both lobbyist and associated registrant.
Preserve historical employer and filer text from printable documents separately from nested current registrant and lobbyist masters.
PAC names and disclosed person or organization names remain unresolved source text.
Preserve contribution-item array and printable form order when assigning occurrence locators; do not sort by date first.
Retain API filing_type as amendment evidence because the sampled LD-203 printable amendment did not render amendment status.
Only feca items are FEC financial-reconciliation candidates.
A confirmed FEC match links disclosures of one activity and never duplicates the amount.

revisions.publisher_model: Original mid-year/year-end reports and amendments have distinct filing UUIDs; no parent filing UUID is published.
revisions.effective_projection: Blocked while draft. Preserve every version and validate inferred filer-period chains against printable documents.

checks.rule: Every normalized report has a valid non-null UUID.
Registrant and lobbyist presence matches an accepted filer_type conditional shape.
Explicit no-contributions state and item-array cardinality remain consistent or publish an issue.
Every contribution item retains its JSON locator, raw values, and content digest.
Each non-null amount parses exactly without binary floating point.
Missing documents and API/document differences publish as explicit unobserved, representation-only, normalized-difference, or conflict states.
Unknown contribution types remain preserved but do not enter typed reconciliation.

scenarios: reported item date and decimal amount
printable form has no amendment-status control
printable form has no amendment-status control

use.retention: Preserve complete API responses, record occurrences, source documents selected by policy, and every accepted version indefinitely.
use.disclaimer: Senate Office of Public Records cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from LDA.gov.
